# Formation Benchmarks (Auto-Generated from Battle Simulation)

> 200 simulations per formation per matchup at ★★ stage.
> Each formation tested against all other comps using Tank Front.

## Win Rate by Formation

| Team Comp | Tank Front | Spread | Corner | Best Formation |
|-----------|-----------|--------|--------|---------------|
| Fire+Metal | 60.6% | 60.0% | 40.0% | **Tank Front** |
| Earth+Wood | 80.0% | 69.1% | 70.3% | **Tank Front** |
| Water+Cunning | 27.3% | 40.0% | 23.0% | **Spread** |
| Fire+Valiant | 0.0% | 0.0% | 0.0% | **Tank Front** |
| Metal+Arcane | 0.0% | 9.7% | 40.0% | **Corner** |
| Mixed Carries | 66.7% | 24.8% | 80.6% | **Corner** |

## Formation Descriptions

- **Tank Front**: Valiant/tank pieces in front row, carries behind
- **Spread**: Pieces spread evenly across all 3 rows
- **Corner**: All pieces clustered in one corner
